name: bygones
title: Bygones
description: A local-history theme built as a card-index drawer: each event a typed buff record card in front of the last, its manila date tab stepping left, centre and right, the title on a red head line over feint blue ruling.

tokens.--font-type: the typewriter face: the name, headings, card titles and all running text
tokens.--font-caps: small grotesque capitals: tabs, menu, stamps, founded line, join link, table heads
tokens.--line: pitch of the feint ruling on a card, and the line height typed on it
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capitals
tokens.--color-bg: the page ground, and the white edge round a news picture
tokens.--color-text: text on the ground: headline, page text, menu, join note
tokens.--color-muted: quieter text on the ground: founded line, tag-page kicker, quotations, page count, footer note
tokens.--color-accent: links on the ground, the current menu mark, the rule beside a quotation
tokens.--color-rule: hairlines on the ground: masthead, footer, table rows, menu hover
tokens.--color-card: the buff record cards, the card in the label holder, the mount round a cover
tokens.--color-card-ink: typing on a card, a tab or the regular-week card; the members-only stamp
tokens.--color-card-muted: quieter typing on a card: descriptions, roles, past dates, the dashes between regular times
tokens.--color-card-link: links on a card and the open-to-all stamp
tokens.--color-feint: the feint blue ruling on every card
tokens.--color-red: the red head line under each card title, the cancelled stamp and its strike-through
tokens.--color-tab: manila: tabs, the regular-week card, heading guide cards, the join link, the drawer label
tokens.--color-drawer: inside the drawer, also seen through each rod hole
tokens.--color-cabinet: the drawer's sides and front panel
tokens.--color-brass: the label holder round the name and its rivets, the drawer's label frame and rod end
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--color-focus: outer ring of the focus outline
tokens.--color-focus-ring: inner ring of the focus outline
tokens.--shadow-card: the shadow a card or tab casts on the card behind
tokens.--shadow-edge: the small shadow under a card edge or a cover
tokens.--shadow-well: the shade inside the drawer and each rod hole
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of cards, the label holder and code
tokens.--radius-tab: rounding of a tab's shoulders and the join link
tokens.--tab-h: height of a tab, and how far each card rises over the one behind
tokens.--tab-min: least width of a tab, so a date fits on one line
tokens.--hole: diameter of the punched rod hole
tokens.--side: width of the column beside the drawer on wide screens
